title: Compact objects detect quasi-coherent derived isomorphisms
statement: Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme [def-pc-scheme] and choose any derived category [def-pc-derived-category], with its universe-$u$ coproducts [lem-pc-derived-qcoh-direct-sums]. For any morphism $g:A\to B$ of $D_{QCoh}(X)$, if $Hom(P,g):Hom(P,A)\to Hom(P,B)$ is bijective for every compact object $P$ [def-pc-compact-object], then $g$ is an isomorphism.

source.place: Tag 09IS (perfect-theorem-bondal-van-den-Bergh); compactness Tag 09M1; detection step of Tag 0A9R

proof.text: Choose small-Hom models on X and its opens using K-injective resolutions. Localization equivalences preserve quasi-coherence, compactness, Hom sets, and isomorphisms. Work in these models; Noetherian X is qcqs.

Complete g to a distinguished triangle A -> B -> C -> A[1]. Its cone has quasi-coherent cohomology by exactness. Every shift of a perfect object is perfect and compact. Hom bijections from these shifts and the long exact Hom sequence give Hom(P[n],C)=0 for all perfect P and integers n.

The objects Q satisfying Hom(Q[n],C)=0 for every n form a class closed under isomorphisms, shifts, cones by exactness, retracts, and coproducts by the universal property. Perfect generation identifies this class with all of D_QCoh(X). Hence the identity of C vanishes and C is zero. Exactness gives bijectivity of Hom(T,g) for every T, and Yoneda makes g invertible. Transfer back. This also covers the empty scheme.

lean.statement:
theorem derivedQCoh_compact_detection (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))] :
    let _ : HasCoproducts.{u} (schemeDerivedQCohCategory X) := derivedQCohDirectSums X
    ∀ (A B : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X) (g : A ⟶ B),
      (∀ P : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X, IsCompactObject P →
        Function.Bijective (fun a : P ⟶ A ↦ a ≫ g)) → IsIso g
